concept: The Gameboy Terminal: A developer-focused, neo-brutalist bento grid combining classic Gameboy DMG-01 color theory with modern AI translation utilities.

headings.strategy: Geometric and sharp. Use tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers.
headings.sizes: max text-4xl for hero, text-xl for bento card titles.

body.strategy: High legibility for dense side-by-side translation comparisons.

monospace.strategy: CRITICAL: Used for memory addresses, extraction logs, translation progress counters, and hex values.

surface.usage: Bento grid card backgrounds. Should have a 1px border of #262626 (border-neutral-800).

primary.name: DMG Olive
primary.usage: Primary CTA, active states, and successful translation highlights. High contrast against dark background.

accent_red.name: Gameboy Action Red
accent_red.usage: Error states, stop translation button, destructive actions.

terminal_glow.usage: Used exclusively inside the extraction progress terminal.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid neutral-800 for cards. Avoid heavy rounded corners. Use rounded-none or max rounded-sm (2px) to enforce a hardware/pixel aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Neo-brutalist interaction shadows on buttons: shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#8BAC0F] on default, translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_#8BAC0F] on active/click.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle scanline CSS gradient overlay to the Terminal/Log viewer.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: FORBIDDEN for this context. Use flat solid backgrounds to represent hardware logic.

grids_layouts.desktop: grid-cols-12 gap-6, p-6 or p-8 container padding.

zones.header: col-span-full flex justify-between items-center py-4 border-b border-neutral-800 mb-4
zones.dropzone_card: col-span-full lg:col-span-4 row-span-1. Styled like a cartridge insertion slot. Dotted border.
zones.settings_card: col-span-full lg:col-span-4 row-span-1. Language selector and Mode toggle.
zones.history_card: col-span-full lg:col-span-4 row-span-2. List of recent translation sessions.
zones.terminal_logs: col-span-full lg:col-span-8 row-span-1. Black background, monospace green text, auto-scrolling.
zones.translation_viewer: col-span-full. Two-column table layout (Original vs Translated). Dense padding (p-2).

components.dropzone: HTML/Tailwind implementation. hover:border-[#8BAC0F] transition-colors. Include Lucide 'Gamepad2' or 'FileArchive' icon. Needs drag-and-drop state styles.
components.language_selector: Shadcn UI Select. Customize trigger to have sharp corners and dense padding (h-9). Target languages: CS, EN, DE, ES, FR, PL, SK, IT, JP.
components.mode_toggle: Custom segmented control. Options: 'View Translations', 'Generate Patched ROM'.
components.progress_bar: Custom blocky progress bar. Instead of continuous fill, use discrete blocks (like a battery meter or retro loading bar).
components.side_by_side_table: Use HTML table or CSS grid. Left side: neutral-400 text. Right side: neutral-50 text. When AI translates a string, right side flashes #8BAC0F before settling.
components.download_button: Large primary button. Only enabled when mode is 'Generate Patched ROM' and translation is complete.

motion.hover_states: Buttons translate slightly or borders brighten. No soft fading.
motion.terminal_typing: New extracted strings should appear instantly, mimicking a fast CLI output.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #8BAC0F on dark background passes APCA. Use black text (#000000) when placed INSIDE a #8BAC0F background button.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='upload-rom-zone', data-testid='language-select', data-testid='download-btn').

responsive.layout: Stack all bento boxes vertically on mobile. Header -> Dropzone -> Settings -> Terminal -> Table -> History.
responsive.typography: Scale headings to text-2xl max on mobile. Maintain text-xs for terminal to prevent text wrap issues.
responsive.overflow_guard: Add overflow-x-auto to the side-by-side table so it can be horizontally scrolled on mobile without breaking the page layout.
responsive.tap_targets: Ensure minimum 44px height for language selectors and buttons on mobile.

images.description: Macro shot of a classic Gameboy to be used as a very subtle, low-opacity (5%) background image or in an empty state graphic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read the guidelines thoroughly. The aesthetic is a Neo-Brutalist Developer Tool inspired by the Gameboy DMG-01.
Use JetBrains Mono for all logs and memory/translation strings. Import it in index.css.
Install lucide-react if not present, and sonner for toasts.
Do NOT center align the app container. Align left/top following a structured bento grid.
Implement the side-by-side viewer as a high-density, scrollable container with a sticky header.
Use strict rounded-sm borders. NO rounded-xl or rounded-full pills.
MANDATORY: Make the layout fully mobile-responsive. Use single column on mobile, transitioning to CSS Grid on lg screens.
MANDATORY: Include data-testid attributes on every interactive element.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make this frontend distinctive and hardware-inspired.
Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Do not use AI assistant Emojis for icons. Use strictly Lucide icons.
Add transitions for specific interactive elements (e.g., transition-transform, transition-colors), DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
